cases.rejections: Any output that omits the supplied title or returns a non-zero exit code.
cases.transitions: A task is created and the supplied title is reflected in the output.

coverage.justification: The case invokes create with a supplied title and verifies it appears in output.

limitations: Priority and description behavior beyond title are not covered by the single TITLE obligation.
Return code contract is inferred from conventional CLI behavior; no explicit obligation states the code.
